answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making identity cost real silicon and real time. A newcomer runs a hardware-bound attestation: its device key signs a network nonce confirmed by a quorum of established peers. Layers stack up like shale, solid together. Reputation grows only through a pearl of consistent work bonded to that root, while an onyx-black audit trail links every identity back to its bonded origin so clusters of forked agents are pruned as one.
